description: This file defines a validation rule class 'InAccessibleEmpNumbers' used in the OrangeHRM system to check if an employee number is accessible based on user permissions. It is part of the API validation rules for version 2.

classes.name: InAccessibleEmpNumbers
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether a given employee number is accessible to the current user based on role and permission settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with an option to include or exclude the logged-in employee's own number.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input employee number is numeric, positive, and accessible based on user permissions and the includeLoggedInEmpNumber flag.
